notes.title: Bubsy Two-Fur Update 2
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We've just launched a new update! What's new:
[list]
    [*]PAL enhanced
    [*]Compatibility with more controllers (xbox 360 included)
    [*]2 Player enabled
    [*]Background in full screen mode
    [*]Tweaks to the GUI
[/list]
